import sys

def dfs(repunits, n, idx):
    quot = n // repunits[idx]
    rem = n % repunits[idx]
    used = quot * idx
    if rem == 0:
        return used
    else:
        return used + min(dfs(repunits, rem, idx - 1),
                          idx + dfs(repunits, repunits[idx] - rem, idx - 1))

def main():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    repunits = [0] * 17
    for i in range(1, 17):
        repunits[i] = 10 * repunits[i - 1] + 1
    result = dfs(repunits, n, 16)
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
